_about: Public-domain S. D. Gordon (Samuel Dickey Gordon, 1859-1936), American lay evangelist and devotional writer, for the Word Hoard: his Quiet Talks series from Quiet Talks on Power (1903) to Quiet Talks on How to Pray (1929), with A Quiet Talk with Those Who Weep (1915) and The Bent-Knee Time (1918). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 72 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
